product_overview: A static multi-page corporate portfolio website showcasing company overview, services, projects and contact capabilities with interactive front-end components (hero slider, project dashboard, charts, and contact validation). The site focuses on clear navigation, responsive design, and client-side interactivity using Swiper.js and Chart.js.
core_goals: Ensure reliable global navigation across all pages and consistent active link state
Validate interactive components (hero slider, project filters, modals, charts) behave as designed
Confirm responsive layout and mobile navigation across defined breakpoints
Enforce visual and brand consistency (typography, color tokens, button styles)
Validate client-side contact form validation and graceful handling when JS/CNDs fail
Verify accessibility basics (alt text, focus indicators, keyboard navigation) and performance targets (LCP, FID, CLS)

features.name: Global Navigation
features.description: Sticky header navigation that allows users to move between Home, Who We Are, Projects, Services and Contact pages and indicates the active page state.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Use navigation to go to /about.html -> Observe page transition to /about.html -> Use navigation to go to /projects.html -> Observe page transition to /projects.html
Navigate to /projects.html -> Use navigation to go to /contact.html -> Observe page transition to /contact.html -> Return to / -> Observe active link state updates for Home
Navigate to / -> Use navigation to go to /non-existent-page.html -> Observe page does not render expected content and a 404 or broken page state is shown

features.name: Home Page Hero Slider
features.description: Auto-playing and interactive hero banner that cycles slides, shows progress, and links into deeper pages via CTAs.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Observe first slide visible with initial animation -> Wait 6 seconds -> Observe auto-advance to next slide and progress reset -> Interact with slider navigation to move between slides -> Use a slide CTA to navigate to /services.html -> Observe page transition to /services.html
Navigate to / -> Swiper library fails to load (CDN or JS error) -> Observe first slide remains static and slide navigation/auto-advance do not function

features.name: Projects Dashboard Filtering
features.description: Client-side search and filter system on /projects.html that updates project cards by title, location, category and status without server calls.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects.html -> Type 'Metering' into the search input -> Observe project cards update to match the query -> Select 'Ongoing' status filter -> Observe result set reduce to ongoing Metering projects -> Clear filters -> Observe all projects are displayed
Navigate to /projects.html -> Type 'xyz-notfound' into the search input -> Observe 'No projects found matching the criteria' message displayed

features.name: Project Modal (Details Overlay)
features.description: On the projects dashboard, selecting a project opens an overlay populated from the client-side projects dataset showing full project details and allows closing while maintaining background state.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects.html -> Select a project from the grid -> Observe a modal overlay opens with project title, description, client and status -> Close the modal -> Observe modal closes and the project grid remains visible
Navigate to /projects.html -> Select a project from the grid -> Modal fails to open due to JS error -> Observe no overlay and a console error logged

features.name: Data Analytics Charts
features.description: Responsive Chart.js visualizations on /projects.html showing portfolio breakdown (doughnut for status, bar for category values) with tooltips on hover.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects.html -> Scroll to charts area -> Observe doughnut and bar charts render with correct dataset proportions -> Hover over a chart segment -> Observe tooltip with numeric value
Navigate to /projects.html -> Chart.js library fails to load -> Observe blank canvases where charts should appear and no tooltips

features.name: Contact Form Validation
features.description: Client-side validation on /contact.html that enforces required fields and email format and prevents submission when inputs are invalid.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact.html -> Fill in First Name, Last Name, a valid Email, Subject and Message -> Submit the contact form -> Observe successful submission flow or confirmation UI (client-side)

Navigate to /contact.html -> Fill in First Name and Last Name but enter an invalid email format and leave Subject empty -> Submit the contact form -> Observe inline validation messages for Email and Subject and form is not submitted

features.name: Mobile Menu Toggle
features.description: Hamburger toggle for mobile viewports that reveals the navigation in a vertical layout and closes on navigation selection.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Resize viewport to mobile width (≤1024px) -> Open the mobile menu via toggle -> Observe navigation links appear in a vertical layout -> Use navigation to go to /contact.html -> Observe menu closes and page transitions to /contact.html

Navigate to / -> Resize viewport to mobile width (≤1024px) -> With JavaScript disabled or toggle script failing, attempt to open mobile menu -> Observe hamburger toggle has no effect and navigation links remain inaccessible via the menu
